support.quote: Broad genetic influence on the five dimensions of Neuroticism, Extraversion, Openness, Agreeableness, and Conscientiousness was estimated at 41%, 53%, 61%, 41%, and 44%, respectively.

assessments.note: Twin study: 41–61% per dimension, i.e. roughly half.

support.quote: The average effect size was .40, indicating that 40% of individual differences in personality were due to genetic, while 60% are due to environmental influences.

assessments.note: Meta-analysis of 62 samples gives 40%, the low end of the 40–60% range the notes accept; 'about 50%' is the usual twin-study round figure.

support.quote: openness to experience was estimated to have a 57% genetic influence, extraversion 54%, conscientiousness 49%, neuroticism 48%, and agreeableness 42%.
